hints.title: Euclidean Distance Squared
hints.text: A point (px, py) lies within a circle (cx, cy, r) if and only if (px - cx)^2 + (py - cy)^2 <= r^2.

hints.title: Avoid Floating Point Roots
hints.text: Compare squared distance against squared radius directly to eliminate precision errors.

hints.title: Query Iteration
hints.text: Iterate over all points for each circle query and count satisfying points.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Points and queries are at most 500, so direct pairwise testing takes only 2.5 * 10^5 operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Integer arithmetic distance comparison avoids floating point square roots in constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses (dx * dx + dy * dy <= r * r) without square root calculation.
